scope: Comparative research queue across100 provisional USA pool records. No alpha completions, estimated QALYs, cost-effectiveness results or donation endorsements.

method.decision_rule: Prioritize plausible marginal US-resident health impact per unrestricted whole-organization dollar, moderated by causal distance, portfolio dilution, realistic implementation and ability to falsify the hypothesis.
method.ranking_interpretation: Numbers order research, not proven impact. Adjacent ordering is low confidence. No financial denominator, quantitative EV model or comparative causal effect has yet been established.
positive_filters: Durable population exposure or injury-prevention changes with a concrete implementation target.
Effective-care access for severe unmet need with observable patient follow-through.
Volunteer or donated-input delivery only when real additionality and all resource costs can be reconciled.
A named whole recipient whose main portfolio could plausibly carry the health pathway.
negative_filters: Awareness, contacts, referrals, coalition wins or benefit dollars treated as health outcomes.
International or nonhealth portfolio dilution under unrestricted giving.
Manufacturer or public-payer subsidy without additional effective treatment.
Unresolved fiscal sponsorship, merger accounting or ordinary donor-recipient route.
Historic accomplishments substituted for current marginal opportunity.
method.no_diversity_quota: Mechanism breadth helps test independent hypotheses, but no cause received a guaranteed place. Similar pathways were compared for causal proximity and whole-gift clarity.
method.source_method: Prior checked primary-source packets and independent acceptance findings reused, with only two new targeted organization checks. Source self-report is not independent effectiveness validation.
method.eligibility_limit: Selection holds do not reverse discovery acceptance. Current revocation/closure checks were not exhaustively repeated; any such adverse finding excludes a candidate before S25 acceptance.
method.time_accounting: Only two new dedicated organization retrieval intervals recorded. Cross-pool comparison and synthesis are untimed; no batch duration allocated to organizations. Prior session IDs are references, not new credits.
